components.provenance: Bounded sparse discovery wrapper around existing Living searchWorlds and enterKey APIs. It caps rows and pages, supports cancellation, rejects stale cross-system results, preserves continuation cursors and never enumerates the universe or directly mutates canonical selection.

Living-native current-location, breadcrumb, selection, debounced announcement, focus recovery and accessible bounded-discovery UI. It preserves canonical aria-pressed rail semantics while adding aria-current; discovery delegates all travel to the public Living enterKey operation; no canonical input, scale, camera, selection, persistence or science authority is introduced.

Lane-owned skip-link, current-context and discovery presentation, compact safe-area, 44px+ critical targets, explicit focus-visible and scoped reduced-motion styling. No product truth or input authority.
